notes.title: Day of the Dead Update!
notes.content:
Content update at last!
There's a new game mode available, which unlocks a new area to explore. A new puzzle leads to an alternate ending and achievement!
Of course, there's a trick to enable that new game mode.
All I can say is that you'll need to give some parts to get a new one.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]New game mode: INFINITE[/h1]
A responsible citizen and esteemed reviewer of the game commented that he wished for a 1000-lives game mode. I liked the idea, but since I'm a contrarian I couldn't do exactly that. So I've made an [i]Infinite Mode[/i]. There might be side effects though. You'll find the option when launching a new game. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few invisible triggers that would block the nurse's vision
[*]Fixed the collision between the sink and boxes
[*]Fixed the pause menu that was displayed behind the end credits
[/list]
[h1]Thank you for the reviews[/h1]
Huge thanks to those who reviewed the game!
If you haven't done so, please write a few words, it helps!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 notes 3/31/2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved lighting and reflections
[*]Inverted a door for better navigation

[/list]

Don't hesitate to report any issues and share your suggestions! 

Also, if you could please review the game. It helps the discoverability of the game a lot!
Thank you so much for your support!
